objective: Compute the IEC 60909-style maximum and minimum three-phase short-circuit currents at a 10.5 kV bus from positive-sequence per-unit impedances.

title.en: REL-TASK-033 — IEC 60909-style maximum and minimum three-phase short-circuit currents
title.ru: REL-TASK-033 — Максимальный и минимальный токи трёхфазного КЗ в духе МЭК 60909

objective.en: Compute the IEC 60909-style maximum and minimum three-phase short-circuit currents at a 10.5 kV bus from positive-sequence per-unit impedances.
objective.ru: Рассчитать максимальный и минимальный токи трёхфазного КЗ на шинах 10,5 кВ по сопротивлениям прямой последовательности в относительных единицах в духе МЭК 60909.

instructions.en: Use short_circuit_case. Sum the positive-sequence impedances to get the network impedance. Maximum current (equipment rating): Ik_max = voltage_factor_cmax / |Z_network| * I_base with a bolted fault (no fault resistance), I_base = base_mva / (sqrt(3) * voltage_kv); Sk_max = sqrt(3) * voltage_kv * Ik_max. Minimum current (protection sensitivity): Ik_min = voltage_factor_cmin / |Z_network + fault_resistance_pu| * I_base. Report ik_max_ka, sk_max_mva, ik_min_ka, z_bolted_mag_pu, z_min_mag_pu.
instructions.ru: Используйте short_circuit_case. Сложите сопротивления прямой последовательности и получите сопротивление сети. Максимальный ток (выбор аппаратов): Ik_max = voltage_factor_cmax / |Z_сети| * I_база при металлическом КЗ (без сопротивления в месте КЗ), I_база = base_mva / (sqrt(3) * voltage_kv); Sk_max = sqrt(3) * voltage_kv * Ik_max. Минимальный ток (чувствительность защиты): Ik_min = voltage_factor_cmin / |Z_сети + fault_resistance_pu| * I_база. Укажите ik_max_ka, sk_max_mva, ik_min_ka, z_bolted_mag_pu, z_min_mag_pu.

short_circuit_case.fault_location: 10.5 kV switchgear bus downstream of the station transformer

positive_sequence_impedances_pu.description: upstream grid Thevenin equivalent on the 100 MVA, 10.5 kV base
station transformer leakage impedance on the same base
short bus duct and connection impedance

short_circuit_case.fault_resistance_note: fault/contact resistance applies to the minimum-current case only; the maximum current is computed for a bolted fault per IEC 60909

submission_schema.ik_max_ka: maximum initial symmetrical three-phase RMS short-circuit current in kA (c_max, bolted fault)
submission_schema.sk_max_mva: maximum short-circuit apparent power in MVA, sqrt(3)*V_kV*Ik_max
submission_schema.ik_min_ka: minimum three-phase RMS short-circuit current in kA (c_min, fault resistance included)
submission_schema.z_bolted_mag_pu: magnitude of the positive-sequence network impedance without fault resistance, per unit
submission_schema.z_min_mag_pu: magnitude of the impedance including fault resistance, per unit

hard_constraints: Submission must contain numeric ik_max_ka, sk_max_mva, ik_min_ka, z_bolted_mag_pu, and z_min_mag_pu fields.
The maximum current must be computed with voltage_factor_cmax and a bolted fault; the minimum current with voltage_factor_cmin and the published fault resistance.
The values must match the independent positive-sequence calculation within tolerance.
Unknown extra answer keys are infeasible.

metrics.name: feasible
metrics.description: Whether the submitted current, MVA, and impedance magnitude satisfy all hard constraints.
